scope: Public synthetic Ollama development qualification only; no private code, secrets, persistent service, production or replacement of Flint/Groq

public_standard_runner_price.detail: GitHub says standard GitHub-hosted runners are free for public repositories; larger runners are always charged.

runner_documented_hardware.detail: ubuntu-latest public standard: 4 CPU, 16 GB RAM, 14 GB SSD; no Ollama runtime measurement.

runner_for_development_test.detail: Actions is intended for software development/testing; test must relate to public repository and impose proportionate burden.

runner_as_continuous_ai_backend.detail: Actions must not be used as serverless application or stand-alone commercial service; ephemeral jobs cannot serve as an always-on inference endpoint.

model_qwen2_5_coder_3b_instruct_license.detail: Official model card identifies qwen-research, not Apache-2.0; exclude from Wolf commercial worker qualification.

account_storage_headroom.detail: Artifact/cache storage can be metered; account-level usage and budgets not independently checked. Avoid uploads/caches.

real_ollama_inference.detail: No Ollama inference receipt or measured resource profile in this Loop 2 run.

private_data_isolation.detail: Never checkout private Factory or expose private prompts/secrets in public runner.

next_ready: Loop 3: prepare bounded workflow_dispatch-only public synthetic 0.5B Ollama smoke test, with no artifact/cache upload, no secrets, explicit timeout and no persistent server, only after policy gate review.
Loop 4: independently verify actual run SHA, model digest, inference receipt, CPU/RAM/disk/time, failure handling, no leakage; do not confuse mock tests with inference.
Loop 5: enforce no production integration and maintain Flint/Groq while Ollama remains NOT_QUALIFIED.
